results.rationale: Consistency: Excluding the requested reduction in apple count, the white background remains, but the glass plate has substantially different, darker radial grooves and the surviving apple has a different rounded shape, stem and skin texture. Instruction: Six apples become exactly one red apple on the plate, matching the expected single-apple result completely. Quality: Structure, lighting and fruit texture are coherent; a faint isolated curved gray mark below the front rim is a small distracting artifact.

Consistency: The white background, centered trouser silhouette, button, belt loops, pockets and hems are retained, but the fly construction visibly changes from a straight narrow closure to a broader curved stitched panel. Instruction: The ivory fabric becomes blue throughout both legs and waistband, precisely fulfilling the expected blue-pants change. Quality: Coherent tailoring and leg shapes, natural fabric shading, clean edges and intact seams; no noticeable generation artifacts.
